snippet.title: EVERSPACE 2 | Wrath of the Ancients — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients is available now on Steam, GOG, Xbox, and PlayStation!

 It’s time to take flight through an all-new adventure set after the events of EVERSPACE 2, that leads pilots deep into star systems controlled by the Okkar. As Adam and his band of misfits seek the origins of mysterious Ancient ships attacking Human colonies, truths of the Okkar race come to light.

Take flight on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470
Get it on GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/everspace_2_wrath_of_the_ancients
Adventure on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/everspace-2-wrath-of-the-ancients/9n1ln379mj7f
Play on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10060222

Follow us on:
https://www.facebook.com/everspace.game
https://bsky.app/profile/everspace.game
https://twitter.com/everspace_game
https://www.instagram.com/everspace_game/
https://www.reddit.com/r/EverspaceGame/
http://discord.gg/rockfishgames

Music used in and officially licensed for the trailer through positionmusic.com: "Fallen Beyond Reach" by Kings & Creatures & Brandon Lau.

This project is partially made possible through funding from the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action of Germany.
